summary: 最近一次竞品空缺扫描显示：高意图 SERP 的赢家主要是官方 help / referral FAQ 与强信任型 affiliate 页。对 CryptoRebate 来说，最该优先做的不是盲目扩更多低意图页，而是强化 official-site、referral-code、signup-kyc、fees-rebate 这四类页的第一屏答案、受限地区说明、手动输入邀请码 fallback、以及 help-center 风格的注册/验证障碍说明。

findings.topic: binance official site / referral entry trust layer
findings.competitorPattern: Live SERP results for Binance referral queries are crowded with low-trust affiliate pages and spammy code pages; winners repeatedly stress using the official domain and avoiding phishing.
findings.ourGap: Our official-site and referral-code pages should state the official domain, phishing warning, and exact fallback registration path more aggressively in the first screen instead of relying mainly on generic comparison framing.

findings.topic: okx signup with referral code and regional restrictions
findings.competitorPattern: OKX help pages explain that users can sign up via referral link or manually enter a referral code, and they explicitly call out residence-based restrictions and what to do when sign-up fails.
findings.ourGap: CryptoRebate should make manual referral-code fallback and residence-based eligibility much more explicit on OKX signup/KYC pages, not just mention the invite link.

findings.topic: okx referral faq vs dex referral confusion
findings.competitorPattern: OKX surfaces both general referral FAQ pages and DEX referral pages; the SERP can mix them, which creates intent confusion for users trying to register a normal account.
findings.ourGap: We need a clearer page section or dedicated supporting coverage that separates account signup referral, campaign rewards, and DEX referral so users do not misread the path.

findings.topic: bybit signup / kyc help-center style answers
findings.competitorPattern: Bybit help-center pages answer registration and KYC questions directly, including country restrictions, supported signup methods, and document expectations.
findings.ourGap: Our Bybit signup-kyc coverage should read more like an answer page with concrete steps, restricted-country warnings, and document expectations before the CTA.

findings.competitorPattern: Official help content often ranks because it answers what happens when the referral link fails, the code is not applied, or the user is in a restricted jurisdiction.
findings.ourGap: This topic is still under-linked in our hubs; it should be surfaced as a recurring internal-link and distribution candidate across signup-kyc and official-site families.
